name: Looking Glass Quilt
summary: A multi-view image format used by Looking Glass holographic displays. A quilt is a single image containing a grid of views (typically 45 or 48 views for a 5×9 or 4×8 arrangement) captured from slightly different horizontal angles. The Looking Glass display uses a lenticular lens to direct each view to a different angle, creating an autostereoscopic lightfield visible without glasses.

variants.name: Standard Quilt (5×9, 45 views)
variants.description: 45-view quilt. Standard for Looking Glass Portrait and 15.6" displays.

variants.name: High-Res Quilt (8×12, 96 views)
variants.description: Higher view count for Looking Glass 8K and Pro displays. Smoother parallax, higher GPU cost.

hardware_requirements: Looking Glass Bridge software or HoloPlay SDK
pipeline_notes: Games output via Geo-11 or UEVR require an intermediate shader (HoloPlay ReShade shader or HoloUEVR plugin) to generate the multi-view quilt from the stereo pair.
